home.title: Every icon tells a story.
home.subtitle: The sovereign vector icon library rooted in African cultures, craftsmanship, and daily living. Zero fluff, inhabited pixels, frictionless copy-paste.

laws.law1Desc: Few elements, each meticulously carved. The geometric purity of a line carrying centuries of memory.
laws.law2Desc: No gratuitous pixels. Every curve, stroke, and clearance serves a material or cultural purpose.
laws.law3Desc: African natural pigments: pottery terracotta, Fulani linen, Asante Kente gold, and Ndop indigo.
laws.law4Title: Code as an Act of Liberation
laws.law4Desc: Instant copy-paste without opaque dependencies. Export clean SVG, React JSX, or Iconify prefix.
